key: Who you are. You are Lewis Galdy. He was a real person, born in France in 1659. His family were Huguenots, French Protestants. France punished them for their faith, so Lewis sailed to Jamaica.

key: Swallowed. The wet sand has gone soft, like mud. You sink up to your neck. You cannot move. Then the ground shakes again!

key: Stay, or go?. Your town is under the sea. Across the water, people are starting again. What will you do?

key: Most people left. Most people crossed the water. Their new town became Kingston. But the real Lewis Galdy stayed. He grew rich and helped build a new church.

key: Here lies Lewis Galdy. “Here Lyes the Body of LEWIS GALDY Esq. who departed this Life at Port Royal the 22d December 1739, Aged 80. He was Born at Montpelier in France, but left that Country for his Religion, and came to settle in this Island, where he was swallowed up in the Great Earthquake in the Year 1692, and By the Providence of God was by another Shock thrown into the Sea, and Miraculously saved by swimming until a Boat took him up. He lived many Years after in great Reputation, Beloved by all that knew him, and much Lamented at his Death.”

He lived many Years after in great Reputation, Beloved by all that knew him, and much Lamented at his Death.

key: The End. Lewis Galdy lived 47 more years. His stone does not say what he sold to get rich. Abba would tell it another way. Two new pages are in your journal.

key: What happened next. The ships sailed. Morgan’s men took the city of Panama, and it burned. About 1,200 men marched with him. Later the King made Morgan a knight. He came back to help rule Jamaica, and hanged pirates. He died in 1688. In 1692 the earthquake took his grave into the sea.
text: What happened next. The ships sailed. Morgan's men took the city of Panama, and it burned. About one thousand two hundred men marched with him. Later the King made Morgan a knight. He came back to help rule Jamaica, and hanged pirates. He died in sixteen eighty-eight. In sixteen ninety-two the earthquake took his grave into the sea.
